Name: Aircraft Recovery (AR) KIT Management
Definition: Knowledge and ability to plan, operate and maintain the AR KIT and SOPs in line with OEM requirements and safety procedures. Knowledge of the procedures anf regulatory requirements of aircraft recovery.

Name: Airport Certification Management
Definition: Knowledge of international and local requirements to achieve a successful airport certification. Ability of populating and preparing the application and procedures required for certification including Aerodrome Manual, Emergency plan, Safety Management system, Security Program, wildlife plan, Maintenance plan, Fire Manual, as well as Driving Certification Process.

Name: Airport Risk Management
Definition: Ability to identify and assess the undesired or adverse events that can lead to the occurrence of a hazard. Knowledge of both reactive and proactive methods and techniques for hazard identification. Ability to develop control measures against the identified risks.

Name: Audit & Assessment
Definition: Ability to plan and perform audit activities in all Airport operations in line with PACA and ICAO standards and regulations covering Safety Management Systems, Rescue and Firefighting, Wildlife and Foreign Object Management, Winter operations, Operation in reduced visibility and Runway Incursion Prevention. Ability to carry out investigations and inspections whenever needed and carry out competency assessment of Airport personnel on regular basis.

Name: Crisis Management
Definition: Knowledge of the Emergency guidelines and actions to be taken after a crisis has occurred. Knowledge of the potential impact of various types of crises and how to minimize the scope of damage. Abiliity to prepare an action plan addressing various kinds of crisis in order to minimize the damage.

Name: Knowledge of Regulations(Strategy)
Definition: Knowledge and understanding of the international standards and regulations of ICAO and PACA, compliance standards and operations, as well as safety and security regulations. Knoweldge and understanding of the Obstacle Limitation Surfaces (OLS)

Name: Stakeholder Management(C&C)
Definition: Understanding of the various stakeholders mainly Oman Air, PACA and ROP, involved in airport operations and an ability to liaise with them for auditing and certification procedure, simulations, emergency situations, action planning and training.

Name: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)  Management
Definition: Ability to examine existing SOPs, identify shortfalls, and develop an action plan. Ability to prepare comprehensive set of SOPs through effective data collection, documentation, developing formats, reviewing the approval process. Ability to identify the requirements and systems needed to ensure that new SOPs are understood and implemented correctly.

Name: Aviation Industry Knowledge (Commercial)
Definition: It is the understanding of the aviation industry business operations, the internal (knowledge, management, and workforce) and external (economy, competitors, and technology) driving forces, passenger growth, socio-economic factors impacting the aviation industry, and market dynamics. It also includes an overview of the business operations, key cost components, revenue and profitability drivers, and key performance matrices.

Name: Billing and Invoicing
Definition: It is the understanding of the billing and invoicing process applicable to various accounts (aero and non aero) at OA. It includes an understanding of the billing terms and conditions, milestones and other applicable KPIs. It also includes an understanding of the MIS covering the billing and collections and an ability to follow up with the customers on payments.

Name: Budget Development and Control (Commercial)
Definition: It is the understanding of the process of developing the budgets as well as the ability to develop budgets for the department factoring in both operating expenses and capital expenditures. It also includes the skill of reviewing the budgets at regular intervals to ensure adherence.

Name: Business Case Development and Analysis
Definition: It is the ability to prepare a business cases by identifying, sourcing and organizing the information in a logical manner to enhance revenue opportunities. The ability to carry out cost-benefit analysis, including the time value of money, present value concepts, and quantifying tangible and intangible benefits.

Name: Commercial Acumen
Definition: The ability to identify key cost elements as well as key drivers of costs and revenues, including pricing.  It includes the ability to use this understanding to identify ways to control costs and maximize revenue, to enhance service and organizational profitability. The ability to identify areas of revenue leakage.

Name: Concession Management
Definition: It is the understanding of aero and non-aero concession segments covering hospitality, retail, services, fuel farm, in-flight catering, ground handling, and cargo handling. It includes an understanding of their revenue/cost structure, operation model, and key performance matrices. It is the ability to manage the service provider and revenue generated from the concession contract to ensure smooth operations for OA.

Name: Financial Forecasting and Projections
Definition: It is the knowledge of the industry growth drivers including social, economic and demographics. An ability to understand and apply the forecasting tools and techniques and identify trends & to understand the influence of market drivers. It also includes the ability to carry out market research (where required) and track developments impacting the business.

Name: Key Account Management
Definition: It is the skill of Identifying opportunities and taking action to build relationships between OA and other internal and external stakeholders to help achieve business goals. It is the ability to source and retain contracts and key accounts (Aero and Non-Aero) through networking, proactive relationship management, understanding customer needs and effective business case presentation.

Name: Market Intelligence
Definition: It is an ability to analyse data from various sources such as business intelligence tools to help OA make informed decisions in relation to passenger movement and buying trends. It is also an ability to interpret trends in aviation, passenger behavior, airline expansion plans, airport service provision, and tourism and ability to relate to  OA business.  It includes the ability to carry out analytics on aero, non aero, and property revenues and align OA strategy to maximize the revenues. .Including any other business relevant information relating to the individual's area of responsibility

Name: Parking, Transportation, and Tariff Segment Understanding
Definition: It is an understanding of the operational aspects of the parking area, transportation and tariff segment. It includes an understanding of their revenue/cost structure, operation model, and key performance matrices for all.

Name: Pricing Strategy Development
Definition: The ability to design and develop a pricing strategy covering pricing models, profit drivers, customer value, and customer satisfaction. This also includes the ability to prepare pricing recommendations based on analysis of market intelligence that are also in line with the legal and regulatory framework. The ability to monitor and revise pricing strategy, and benchmark them against market trends while supporting OA's business initiatives.

Name: Property Management
Definition: It is the knowledge of the assets and resources available from OA and the ability to identify the tenancy mix and target tenants and pursue and attract them to invest in the OA real estate (lease from OA). It includes the skill of negotiating the terms and conditions, finalizing lease rentals and the lease agreements. It also includes being in touch with the tenants and addressing their queries/ concerns and grievances relating to property and taking appropriate action to maintain their satisfaction levels. The understanding of prevailing market rates and the ability to set OA's rates in line with market rates.

Name: Real Estate Development
Definition: It is the ability to understand and implement the real estate master plan for OA and finalizing the model for identifying and attracting potential investors. It includes the skill of preparing a business case for investment and influencing the potential investors.

Name: Route Development
Definition: It is the ability to understand targeted airlines' network strategy, identify potential route targets,  and meet with the decision makers to negotiate contracts. It is an ability to prepare business cases and meet with the relevant stakeholders to influence and negotiate partnerships. It is also an ability to develop and execute marketing campaigns targeting the airlines/ routes and promoting Oman as a destination.

Name: Stakeholder Management (Commercial)
Definition: Knowledge and understanding of different stakeholders, their needs, priorities and agenda. It includes actively engaging and partnering with them to achieve a common objective.  The ability to liaise with stakeholders such as PACA, IATA,  ICAO and ROP etc. and utilize market intelligence outputs to draft the documentation and prepare the presentation required for consultation meetings with airlines. The ability to influence the airlines' decision in favor of OA.

Name: Accounting Principles & Standards
Definition: It is the knowledge of accounting concepts and principles such as accounts receivable, accounts payable, cash management, general ledger, fixed assets, budgeting, cost accounting, management accounting, and financial consolidation.  It includes the understanding of accounting standards such as IFRS, GAAP or other similar standards. It is also the skill of preparing financial statements such as balance sheet, income statement, and statement of cash flow.

Name: Audit & Assurance
Definition: It is the understanding of the processes and procedures for internal as well as external audits and the requirements for facilitating audits like state audit, ISO audit, internal investigations etc.  It includes the ability to provide high quality audits by evaluating information systems and internal controls, gathering evidence and performing procedures to meet the objectives of audit and assurance engagements.

Name: Aviation & Airport Management Services Sector Knowledge (F&P)
Definition: It is the knowledge and understanding of the aviation and airport management sector business operations, the driving forces, market dynamics including the regulatory framework. It includes gaining an understanding of other competitive markets in GCC / other countries. It also includes an overview of the business operations, key cost components, revenue and profitability drivers and key performance metrics.

Name: Budget Development and Control
Definition: It is the understanding of the process of developing the budgets as well as the ability to develop budgets for the organization/unit/division/department factoring in both operating expenses and capital expenditures. It also includes the skill of reviewing the budgets at regular intervals to ensure adherence.

Name: Contract Dispute Management
Definition: It is the ability to prevent the occurrence of disputes in a contract due to proactive contract management and the ability to resolve disputes amicably through negotiations, arbitration, mediation or litigation in the interest of the organization's business needs. In case of a dispute, apply thorough analytical and critical thinking skills to determine the root cause, calculate claim and communicate it formally using defined reporting mechanisms.

Name: Contracting
Definition: It is the ability to draft and vet contracts as per regulatory and legal frameworks and manage contractors during contract execution.

Name: Expense Accounting & Payments
Definition: It is the knowledge of key expenditure classes applicable to OAMC including understanding of the  controls over expenditures and cost control mechanism along with ensuring  payments are processed in line with contractual requirements.

Name: Finance Strategy
Definition: It is the understanding of the process of developing a long term, medium term and short term strategy for finance, including its various components like strategic financial decision making framework including investment strategy, investment evaluation, dividend policy, financial planning process, financial policy development and balancing the short term and medium term financial goals.

Name: Financial Operations & Reconciliation
Definition: It is the understanding and an ability to record financial transactions in Oracle ERP in line with accounting standards. Ability and skill to verify the accuracy of transactions and records by identifying and resolving any irregularities. Knowledge of reconciliation procedures and ability to perform all types of reconciliations and includes the skill of identifying the areas of revenue leakages.

Name: Financial Planning & Forecasting
Definition: It is the understanding of the principles of financial planning and forecasting and includes the skill to prepare an integrated financial plan for OAMC including developing budgets and forecast scenarios for revenues, cash flow, operating expenses etc. based on OAMC strategy.

Name: Fixed Asset Accounting
Definition: It is the knowledge of the key factors governing classification of procurements as capital (Capex) and operating (Opex) expenses along with accurate accounting of acquisition, disposals, revaluations and capitalization of assets. It also includes an understanding of various methods of depreciation, rates and the process of calculating depreciation on various asset classes.

Name: General Ledger & Payroll Accounting
Definition: It is the knowledge of key adjustments required as part of period end closing process such as provisions, write offs, impairment, fair value adjustments, credit notes, debit notes, accruals and payroll/head count reconciliation.

Name:
Governance 
(Policies & Procedures)
Definition: It is the knowledge of the OA's policies and procedures along with adequate understanding of the application of policy level directives and following the defined processes and authority (as defined in delegation of authority) to ensure effective system of internal controls

Name: Insurance Risk Management
Definition: It is the knowledge of OAMC's risk transfer framework undertaken via insurance. It also includes the knowledge of available insurances coverages and skill of defining risk transfer strategy to optimize the risk exposure and coverage by maintaining active liaison with the insurance provider.

Name: Legal and Regulatory framework understanding (F&P)
Definition: It is the understanding of the Omani Tender law, legal and regulatory framework that is relevant to the tendering process in the organization and ensuring economical and ethical use of resources

Name: Performance Reporting
Definition: It is the skill to prepare various MIS/ financial performance reports that are customized as well as standardized for requirements of internal stakeholders. It is the ability to interpret such reports and share insights on performance of leading and lagging indicators.

Name: Procurement Planning
Definition: It is the ability to plan and develop a strategy and budget for procurement of material in line with the specifications of user departments. It also includes the application of design skills, MIS and management reporting for the function including conducting spend analytics to identify any synergistic potential in procurement for strategic procurement decision making.

Name: Revenue Accounting
Definition: It is the knowledge of key revenue streams i.e. concession fee, parking fees, hanger fees, passenger handling charges, landing fee, etc. and other key contractual terms and conditions governing revenue. It includes timely invoicing and collections of dues to avoid any cash flow difficulty, delinquent receivables and revenue leakages.

Name: Risk Management (Financial & Procurement)
Definition: It is the understanding of the risks including the skill of identifying and evaluating contractual and financial risks, developing the risk treatment strategy and developing and monitoring the financial and contractual risk controls.

Name: Stakeholder Management(Fin & Proc)
Definition: It is the ability to facilitate respective stakeholders interacting directly with Procurement Department to ensure that procurement process efficiency and effectiveness is maintained in an uncompromising manner without impacting operational continuity and business disruption.

Name: Statutory Reporting
Definition: It is the understanding of the regulatory requirements, guidelines and the templates for reporting the business performance. It includes the  skill of reporting the financial performance as per the requirements.

Name: Taxation Management
Definition: It is the understanding of various direct and indirect Tax Laws and Regulations applicable to the business. It also includes skills in calculating tax liability and tax payable along with calculation of deferred tax liability/ asset. Additionally, it includes the ability to provide insights into the implications of various decision for taxation purposes.

Name: Tendering(Finanace)
Definition: It is the knowledge and understanding of the tendering lifecycle, working with end users to ensure that the materials/services procured are aligned with business needs and within the available budget. It also includes the skill of finalizing the evaluation criterion and negotiation with vendors.

Name: Treasury & Banking Operations
Definition: Knowledge about the optimum investment opportunities of term deposits, key terms and conditions. Skill to forecast the cast flow requirements and identification of risk averse investments in-line with company's strategy, management guidelines and risk appetite. Additionally, knowledge about the various financial/leasing facilities available from various financial institutions along with activation of the exit strategy for various investments.

Name: Using IT Applications
Definition: Ability to use MS office suite of products including MS Office and Visio in day to day work situations and also awareness of planning, budgeting and forecasting software's like Hyperion, Business Objects and Aurora. It also includes the ability to use Oracle financial modules to extract information through queries.

Name: Vendor Management
Definition: It is the ability to assess, evaluate and select the right vendors (third-party providers) of materials and services, develop partnership arrangement with key vendors along with supervising day-to-day interactions and managing longer-term relationship in the context of managing organization's costs, mitigate risks and maintaining service excellence.

Name: AFS Personnel Training and Awareness
Definition: Ability to equip all levels of AFS personnel with the necessary theory, principles and skills to perform their tasks.  Carryout practical exercises involving pressure-fed fuel fires to give AFS personnel adequate exposure related to aircraft firefighting, fire station management, tactical fire-fighting, fire safety planning, as well as command and control at aircraft crash site to prepare personnel for their roles as senior fire officers.

Name: AFS Standard Operating Procedure (SOP)  Management
Definition: Ability to examine existing SOPs, identify shortfalls, and develop an action plan. Ability to prepare comprehensive set of SOPs through effective data collection, documentation, developing formats, reviewing the approval process. Ability to identify the requirements and systems needed to ensure that new SOPs are understood and implemented correctly.

Name: Fire and Safety Policy and strategy  planning and risk management
Definition: Ability to develop and implement the fire strategy plan in coordination with internal and external stakeholders, and developing the required documentation. Ability to develop and implement Hazard identification process, Safety risk assessment and mitigation process. Carryout  Fire Safety performance monitoring and measurement as well as internal safety investigation. Conducting Fire Training/ education and Fire safety  awarness

Name: Incident Management
Definition: Ability to manage all types of incidents and accident in an effective manner.  Ability to set clear and defined objectives to resolve the incident through detailed action plans, and carryout effective communication of action plans with various Agencies. Ability to classify various types of safety-breach incidents according to the 3 levels of commands (Bronze, Silver and Gold) system, and to proceed with the immediate required actions in accordance to each category.

Name: Knowledge of Regulations(Fire)
Definition: Knowledge of international and local standards of airport operation and Rescue and Firefighting in accordance with CAR 139, ICAO regulations , Annex 14 - Aerodrome Design and Operations, Airport Service Manual - Annex's (part 1 & 7)

Name: Medical First Aid and Casualty Handling
Definition: Understanding and knowledge of First aid procedures to address different types of casualties. Ability to initiate first aid procedures, provide basic medical assistance and  handle causalities so as to avoid  additional suffering and/or injury in the removal of the injured  in an aircraft or airport accident or incident.

Name: Rescue and Firefighting Operation
Definition: Ability to effectively use the Rescue and Firefighting Equipment (hoses, nozzles, turrets and other appliances required for compliance with ICAO - Annex 14). Ability to use radio communication equipment, proper procedures of radiotelephony communications and basic hand signals. Ability to carryout  search and rescue procedures, in enclosed spaces of an aircraft and areas in the immediate vicinity of an aircraft accident.

Name: Administration
Definition: The ability to plan, direct, or coordinate the administrative services like office facilities management, local/domestic/international travel and logistics, renewal and management of office support services.

Name: Compensation & Rewards
Definition: It is the understanding and ability to develop compensation and rewards strategy by applying compensation and total rewards principles. It includes an understanding of employees' salary and grading structure, carrying out benchmarking surveys, establishing the internal pay ranges for various grades, analyzing trends across employee segments and recommending revision of salary scales.

Name: Employee Engagement
Definition: It is the understanding of key engagement drivers at OA and the process and methods of measuring employee engagement.  It includes the skill of identifying and implementing the tools and identifying initiatives that enhance or sustain the employee engagement at OA.

Name: Employee Relations Management
Definition: Ability to manage employee relations activities such as employee joining formalities for local and expatriate employees and updating personnel files. It includes the ability to handle employee queries/grievances/disciplinary action, interpreting and administering contracts and helping resolve work-related problems.

Name: Fleet Management
Definition: The ability to maintain and monitor fleet requirements such as vehicle registration, insurance expiry date, fleet booking… It includes the ability to maintain an updated database to track the required information, action upon it and avoid any fees imposed for late renewal.

Name: Government Relations
Definition: The ability to understand and interpret labour laws and  visa-related government processes and the implications to OA. It includes taking relevant steps to ensure OA is compliant at all times.

Name: HR Policies Administration
Definition: Understanding of OA HR policies, processes and various  procedures in relation to Omani labour law, processes and procedures  Ability to review, develop, implement, monitor and keep updated Human Resources processes, policies and procedures. It includes implementing the OA policies in a consistent manner across OA.

Name: Learning and Development Execution
Definition: It is the ability to develop an annual training plan and schedule for OA in line with the training needs analysis. It includes identifying internal and external trainers / training partners, enrollment of participants, organizing trainings as per plan, ensuring training coverage, gathering feedback and documentation.

Name: Learning and Development Planning
Definition: It is an understanding of the technical and leadership / behavioral competency framework and its application in learning and development. It includes the ability to identify and consolidate the learning needs for OA and preparing a plan for executing the organization wide learning needs. It also includes prioritizing learning needs, identifying appropriate channels of learning, implementing and measuring the effectiveness  of learning interventions.

Name: Manpower Planning and Budgeting
Definition: It is the ability to develop and align a manpower strategy to overall OA strategy. It includes creation and execution of Omanisation plan and succession planning, identification of positions (new and existing) to be Omanized as well as forecasting the headcount for OA across various departments.

Name: Payroll Process Management
Definition: Understanding of the payroll process, various inputs and its impact on the payroll process. Understanding of employees' salaries, wages, allowances, bonuses, net pay and deductions payable and calculation mechanism medical benefits  and other benefits in line with HR policies and procedures.

Name: Performance Program Management
Definition: It is the knowledge and ability to apply goal deployment concepts and methodologies in line with organizational focus areas. Understanding of its linkages with Rewards, Learning and Development and Career Progression. It includes the ability to develop and manage the performance management cycle, internal communication, training / education / coaching of all employees on PMS process.  Ability to understand and align individual performance to company performance, through targets, goals, metrics and behaviors and to monitor performance of individuals in relation to company performance.

Name: Strategic HR
Definition: It is the understanding of HR from a macro perspective and how it fits and contributes to the overall success of OA. It includes developing and the skill of implementing HR practices to the Strategy of the company by being innovative, identifying leading trends and forecasting likely scenarios and continually improving processes.  It is the ability to plan medium and long term initiatives and positioning HR as a strategic business partner.

Name: Talent Acquisition
Definition: It is an ability to develop a strategy for talent attraction in line with the manpower plans. It includes identifying the sources of talent acquisition, sourcing of candidate profiles, understanding of talent assessment procedures like interviews, tests and final candidate selection.

Name: Talent Management and Development
Definition: Ability to design and implement talent management practices including succession planning, high potential employee identification, leadership development and career planning. It also includes an understanding of competency frameworks, development interventions, methods and tools of assessments, preparation and management of IDPs.

Name: Aviation Regulations
Definition: Knowledge of international and local standards of airport operation's safety including  ICAO regulations , Annex 14 - Aerodrome Design and Operations, Annex 19 - Safety Management, CAR 139, OSH 286 and regulations related to environment protection by Ministry of Environment and Climate Affairs. Knowledge of International Aviation bodies such as ACI, IATA...

Name: Environmental Manual
Definition: The knowledge of the various sources of environmental pollution caused by airlines / airports and neighbouring community which results in noise, air, surface water and visual / lightening pollution. Ability to develop SoPs to manage, eliminate or reduce environmental pollution. Ability to develop performance indicators to assess and control environmental pollution and develop mitigation plans.

Name: HSE Culture
Definition: The ability to create an HSE driven culture in OA by engaging with stakeholders to conduct HSE awareness sessions and campaigns to various stakeholders including third party. This also includes conducting mandatory refresher HSE training.

Name: HSE Monitoring and Inspection
Definition: Ability to develop HSE plans aligned with the operational risks identified. It also includes the ability to conduct routine safety monitoring of airside such as runways, taxiways, aprons, and grass areas, terminal and passenger safety such as parking, food, trollies...

Name: HSE Risk Assessment
Definition: Knowledge of the type of hazards and risks such as runway incursions, adverse weather, FOD to aircraft, major bird strike causing accident, loss of supply of utilities or other major services... The ability to identify and categorize risks. It also includes the skill to evaluate the risk by using the risk assessment tools and techniques and developing mitigation plans.

Name: Investigation
Definition: The ability to conduct investigations related to HSE incidents, reconstruct the events, gather evidence, root cause analysis and arrive to a conclusion. It also includes the ability to prepare investigation reports and recommend corrective actions.

Name: Occupational Health Manual
Definition: The knowledge of international and local regulations on occupational health hazards. Ability to develop SoPs to manage, eliminate or reduce occupational health hazards on employees such as noise, fumes... Ability to develop performance indicators to assess and control health hazards and develop mitigation plans.

Name: Report Analysis
Definition: Understanding and analysis of HSE daily, monthly, quarterly and annual reports including the classification of HSE violations caused by OA, vendors, airline ground handlers and other stakeholders. It also includes the ability to effectively follow up on the closure of the required actions to be taken.

Name: Safety Management System (SMS)
Definition: Understanding of SMS Manual including Aviation Safety procedures covering airside and passenger safety. Ability to develop SoPs to manage, eliminate or reduce Aviation Safety risks and maintain safety of employees, stakeholders and operations. Ability to develop performance indicators to assess and control HSE risks associated with airport operations.

Name: Administration & Coordination
Definition: It is the ability to coordinate departmental activities effectively with internal stakeholders. It includes assisting IA team to schedule meetings and manage internal activities.

Name: Audit Execution
Definition: The ability to understand the various processes /functions and associated risks, develop audit programs for various processes / functions, understand the operating / work procedures and conduct interviews with process owners. Knowledge of the preventive, detective and corrective controls and the ability to test the effectiveness of those controls. Ability to design and implement effective follow-up mechanisms for audit action plans and recommendations.

Name: Balance Scorecard Methodology
Definition: Knowledge of the Balance Scorecard methodology. The ability to apply Balance Scorecard technique to evaluate the performance of the Internal Audit department and review the application of Balance Scorecard to meet OA's vision and strategic objectives.

Name: Business Process Understanding
Definition: Understanding Airport business operations, OA's operating model and processes. It includes using tools such as six sigma, Swim Lane Diagrams, MS Visio applying techniques for business process improvement and documentation.

Name: Collaboration and Cooperation (Team Capabilities)
Definition: A willingness and eagerness to build strong working relationship by collaborating with teams and contributing towards the achievement of a common objective. It includes taking ownership of own task and also supporting others in achieving their tasks

Name: Computer Assisted Auditing Techniques
Definition: The ability to use computer assisted auditing tools such Microsoft office and extraction software. This includes the ability to maintain adequate documentation and supporting evidences using the computer assisted auditing tools.

Name: Conflict Management
Definition: The ability to identify potential conflict, successfully mediate conflict, confrontations or disagreements between individuals and groups and find a common ground with minimum negative impact.

Name: Data Collection and Analysis
Definition: The ability to collect data from various relevant sources, sample and analyze audit data trends, correlation, deviation, gaps, average... to report exceptions. It includes the ability to use data mining and analysis tools such as Excel and other applications and apply sampling techniques effectively. It also includes the ability to apply statistical methodology such regression analysis and use benchmarking data adequately.

Name: Forecasting
Definition: The knowledge and ability to review management forecast and predictions. It includes reviewing assumptions and adequacy of various forecasting techniques adopted considering the nature of forecast.

Name: Fraud Investigation
Definition: The ability to identify the potential risks associated with various processes and validate the data to check for threats / fraud. It includes the ability to carry out investigations on potential fraud/ threats, carry out special reviews, reconstruct the events and gather evidence to arrive at a conclusion. It is also the understanding of whistle-blowing concepts and techniques and litigation and restructuring process.

Name: Governance Risk and Control
Definition: Understanding of different auditing standards implemented at OA and in compliance with government requirements and applicable laws. It includes the understanding of the various frameworks and the relevant standards such as IIA, IPPF, ISO, COSO, TQM... Knowledge of and ability to interpret and apply relevant auditing standards, leading practices and methodologies.

Name: Information System Audit
Definition: Understanding of the ERP application system implemented at OA, the architecture and various modules actively used. The ability to understand the process as they are configured in the application and the controls associated with those processes. Understand the segregation of duties (SoD) matrix and ensure the ERP system is aligned to the SoD matrix. The ability to identify the risks and assess the impact and likelihood of occurrence.

Name: Operational and Management Research
Definition: The knowledge of principles, methods, and techniques used to conduct a systematic and objective research; including data collection, analysis and interpretation of data; and the reporting of results.

Name: Alternative Dispute Resolution
Definition: It is the ability to preempt and prevent the occurrence of legal actions / law suits in a contract and resolve the disputes amicably through negotiations, conciliation, settlements or arbitration in the interest of OA's business needs. It is an ability to discuss and convince two-party/multi-party via negotiations  to take appropriate action and reach a mutually satisfactory agreement.

Name: Corporate Governance
Definition: It is the understanding of OA's corporate governance standards including establishing an awareness of different types of stakeholders and their interests. It is the awareness and an understanding of the corporate governance policies and procedures at OA. It includes the skill of drafting as well as reviewing the policies and procedures from an adequacy and effectiveness standpoint.

Name: Documentation and Archiving Legal
Definition: It is the skill of maintaining adequate legal documentation and evidences that cover the legal risks of OA. It is the skill of archiving the documents while protecting the confidentiality, integrity and reliability of the legal documents.

Name: Internal and External Stakeholder Management
Definition: The understanding of various internal (such as  PACA, Oman air, ISS, ROP (Security), Ground-handler, all OA departments, and concession providers)  and external (such as MOF, MOTC, MOLA, MOCI, SAI, ROP and Muscat Municipality) stakeholders, their needs, priorities and agenda. It includes actively engaging and partnering with them to achieve a common objective.

Name: Legal Advisory
Definition: It is the skill of conducting research, understand, interpret and apply relevant laws and regulations (such as tendering law, commercial companies law, civil law, criminal law, contract law etc.) and provide legal opinions in the interest of OA. It is also an ability to safeguard the OA's legal interest in all related activities.

Name: Legal Drafting and Review
Definition: The ability to draft legal documents such as contracts, agreements, polices, memos, submissions etc. that are in line with local and international laws and regulations and in a manner that protects OA's legal interests. The ability to review legal documents to ensure that the language and the legal risks are in compliance with the local and international legal and regulatory framework. It also includes managing the contracts/ agreements / MoUs and address any clarifications during the contract execution period.

Name: Legal Process Design
Definition: The ability to design the internal legal processes and SOPs covering legal risk management, templates for legal documents, document review, contract management, documentation and archiving. It includes an ability to incorporate industry leading practices and design effective legal processes at OA.

Name: Legal Risk Management
Definition: It is the understand of legal risks including identifying, analyzing, assessing, prioritizing, and mitigating the and developing a legal risk treatment strategy. It includes creating an awareness amongst the internal stakeholders on the legal risks and a culture of identifying and mitigating legal risks.

Name: Legal and Regulatory Framework Understanding
Definition: It is the knowledge and understanding of the local and international legal and regulatory framework governing the operations of OA including applicable aviation related laws and regulations such as PACA, ICAO, IATA, and ACI etc..

Name: Litigation
Definition: The ability to conduct legal action (such as lawsuit, legal dispute, legal case etc.), understand the litigation process and methods leading to the resolution of the legal action in line with the local/international legal action process.  Add intent related behaviors at level  3 and 4

Name: Translation
Definition: The skill of translating legal documents from the English Language to the Arabic Language and vis versa, while maintaining the legal integrity of the document. It includes the skill of proof reading legal documents and generating error free documents.

Name: FM  Planning
Definition: It is the ability to plan, inspect and carry out maintenance of the airport facilities, waste management, pest control, landscaping, facad and roof top cleaning in line with international standards. It includes managing the facilities in a sustainable manner.

Name: Quality Management
Definition: Knowledge of the principles, methods, and tools of quality assurance and quality inspection used to ensure the performed maintenance meets the quality standards required.

Name: Aviation Sector Understanding
Definition: It is the knowledge and understanding of the aviation sector business operations, the driving forces, market dynamics including the regulatory requirements. Understanding of other competitive markets in GCC / other countries and best practices. It also includes an overview of the business operations, key cost components, revenue and profitability drivers and key performance metrics.

Name: Branding
Definition: Ability to assess, position and maintain the OA's brand among internal stakeholders as well as outside the organization. It is an ability to establish a significant and differentiated presence for OA and position OA as a world class organization. It is the ability to plan and execute successful and impactful sponsorship programs with clear and defined goals.

Name: Business Communication
Definition: Ability to communicate effectively for OA's business purpose to internal and external stakeholders through media such as print, Internet, radio, television, word-of-mouth, alternative media, etc. by using skills such as editorial, copywriting, business writing, translations and public speaking. It also includes the skill of drafting and reviewing the press releases in line with internal guidelines.

Name: Campaign Management
Definition: Ability to plan and execute campaigns leading to benefits internally or externally for OA. It includes identification of key messages, communication vehicles, stakeholders, branding and collateral management. Clearly and completely define the Target-Audience and develop campaign’s content appropriate for the Target-Audience.

Name: Corporate Communication Strategy
Definition: Plan, develop and manage an integrated and effective corporate communications strategy for OA. Communicate a cohesive, credible and positive image of OA and its services to internal and external stakeholders such as employees, media, channel partners and the general public. Ability to maintain adequate preparation time for scheduled events/deadlines and develop schedules and timetables with clear, specific milestones and deadlines in collaboration with OA's different stakeholders. Ability to identify critical tasks and priorities systematically, monitor and adjust priorities and/or eliminate tasks on an on-going basis, as well as evaluating results.

Name: Crisis Communication Management
Definition: The ability to develop and implement a Crises Management Plan that holds the lists of key contact information, reminders of what should be done in a crisis, and forms to be used to document the crisis response. Ability to manage the perceptions arising out of the occurrence of unpredictable events that impact an organization's performance and its reputation among internal and external stakeholders.

Name: Digital Media Management
Definition: Ability to populate OA’s websites and Social Media platforms with up-to-date and engaging content in coordination with different internal and external stakeholders.  Ability to optimize search engine and maximize traffic to websites and Social Media Platforms. Ability to carry out an ongoing review of OA’s websites and Social Media Platforms making recommendations to improve accessibility and navigation.  Ability to facilitate online conversations with customers and respond to queries, and report online reviews and feedback from customers.  Ability to develop an optimal posting schedule, considering web traffic and customer engagement levels. Ability to use MS office suite of products in day to day work situations and also awareness of design software such as Adobe Photoshop. It also includes the ability to use Web publishing and graphic design for use in Corporate Communication material.

Name: External Communication
Definition: Ability to plan, develop, and execute external communications, leveraging diverse media (e.g., print, radio, television, sponsorships and events), to facilitate and enable communication between OA and its external stakeholders such as customers & partners, while ensuring optimal returns on investment. It also includes building relationships with various media agencies and vehicles to ensure timely coverage of OA's developments.

Name: Internal Communication
Definition: Ability to plan, develop, and execute internal communications by leveraging diverse media, to facilitate and enable communication between the company's internal stakeholders, primarily its employees. Ensure organizational initiatives and projects are successfully communicated to employees. Storyboard or translate ideas / organizational initiatives to the creative team of art directors / designers / design agencies.

Name: Airfield Operations and Safety
Definition: Understanding of the ICAO Standards and recommendations (An 14, Doc 9137, Doc 9157, Doc 9859 etc.), national Regulations (CAR 139), airfield operations, layout and plan, inspection processes, different stakeholders and their roles and responsibilities and applicable regulations. It includes the knowledge of HSE policies,  processes and procedures as per the applicable HSE standards, safety requirements and regulations governing the safety of the airport as well as the reporting mechanism for any discrepancy/ hazard/ FODs.

Name: Airport Operations Process Understanding
Definition: It is the knowledge of various airport operations processes covering terminal, ground handling, baggage handling, airfield operations, maintenance, HSE, AFS, airport systems and airline processes like flight planning, landing, dispatch, operations control etc. It includes understanding the operations in an integrated manner and an understanding of the interdependencies between different departments. It also includes an awareness of internal and external stakeholders involved in different processes.

Name: Airport Resources Management (AOC)
Definition: It is the understanding of various airport resources like stands, gates, check-in counters, baggage carousels and an ability to utilize them in an efficient and optimum manner. It includes an understanding of the AOC SOPs and the skill of applying them in day to day operations while ensuring safety. It includes  making the resources available and allocating them in a timely and efficient manner and planning for alternatives in case of contingencies  as well as an understanding of the impact of revenue.

Name: Baggage Handling Operations
Definition: Knowledge and understanding of the baggage handling standards and relevant codes (like IATA Tagging Formats, RFID reading, TSA). Understands the process of baggage handling including those for arrival, departure and transfer. Understands the various stakeholders involved and their role. Also it includes an understanding of the impact of baggage handling on the passenger experience. Knowledge and understanding of the SOP's of Baggage Handling System to minimize the operational impact to the delivery of baggage.

Name: Baggage Handling System Operations & Maintenance
Definition: Knowledge and understanding of the standard operating procedures of the baggage handling systems as per OEM requirements. It includes planning and adhering to the planned maintenance requirements by OEM. It also includes the skill of operating the baggage handling systems in a safe and secure manner.

Name: Capacity Analysis and Planning
Definition: It is the ability to analyze the schedule and actual operations data, passengers growth and volumes, cargo volume and baggage's handled to optimize the airport terminal capacity in the short term and medium term. It includes an understanding of the pre planning process and also the skill of preparing the plan ahead of the peak season. It covers the ways and means of maximizing the utilization of airport terminals, identifying resource constraints, bottlenecks and planning airport capacity to meet future demand.

Name: Coordination & AOC Operations
Definition: It is the ability to understand, interpret and communicate using ATC phraseology to communicate with the ATC, Airlines and Ground Handlers. It includes the skill of anticipating bottlenecks  in light of the airline schedule and availability of airport  resources. It covers the skill of sharing the right information with the right team at the right time and an ability to clear the flights in a safe manner. It also includes the ability to effectively address  the stakeholder requests or requirements during the operations.

Name: Customer Experience
Definition: Knowledge and understanding of the customer experience impacting processes and facilities like parking, check-in counters, baggage check-in or collection, baggage screening, customs, duty free shops, restaurants/cafe, commercial activities and medical emergencies. It includes the ability to continuously improve these processes to enhance customer experience. It also includes being sensitive to the needs and requests  of the customers, addressing their complaints / feedback and possessing a service mindset to effectively address such requests.

Name: Manpower Resources Management
Definition: Understanding of the manpower requirements at the terminal / airfield / airport and effectively planning for the availability of such resources. Ability to utilize the available resources including allocation and re-allocation, rostering and scheduling the manpower by balancing between cost and efficiency.

Name: Terminal Facilities Management
Definition: Knowledge and understanding of the repair and maintenance of the facilities and equipment used in the efficient operations of the terminal and adherence to their maintenance schedule. It includes the identification of any gaps and taking corrective actions.

Name: Terminal Operations
Definition: Knowledge of ICAO Annex 9 standards and recommendations and Understanding of the terminal operations, layout and plan, different stakeholders and their roles and responsibilities and applicable regulations. It includes the knowledge of HSE policies,  processes and procedures as per the applicable HSE standards, safety requirements and regulations governing the safety of the airport.

Name: Wildlife Hazard Management
Definition: Knowledge and an understanding of ICAO Standards and recommendations in An 14, Doc 9137-Part 3, the wildlife trends and patterns impacting various airports under OA and developing a strategy to assess and mitigate the hazards arising from wildlife. It includes analyzing survey results, investigating incidents and taking preventive actions. It also includes the ability to develop and implement a reporting mechanism for wildlife.

Name: Process Improvements
Definition: It is the ability to understanding the business processes, benchmark against leading practices, identify gaps and work with process owners to address the process gaps. It also includes the skill of measuring the performance of the process over time.

Name: Quality Certifications Management
Definition: It is the identification and understanding of quality management standards aligned with OA business objectives, preparing a roadmap for their implementation and the skill of institutionalizing such standards in OA. It includes monitoring and reporting the progress on implementation of quality standards.

Name: Quality Culture
Definition: It is the ability to create a culture of quality management at OA by working closely with stakeholders, creating awareness programs, communication and undertaking OA wide initiatives leading to enhanced understanding of quality and related processes.

Name: Airport Security Programme (ASP) Management
Definition: Understand the ICAO requirements of ASP and an ability to develop, review and implement the Airport Security Plan (ASP). It also includes assigning roles and responsibilities, developing the plan, revising, implementing and training of stakeholders.

Name: Knowledge of Regulations(Security)
Definition: Knowledge and understanding of the international standards and recommended practices of ICAO Regulations  (Annex 17, Annex 9)  and the  detailed procedures, guidance, and security measures included in the Aviation Security Manual (Doc 8973- Restricted), National Civil Aviation Security Programmes and Airport Security Programmes.

Name: Security Culture
Definition: Ability to reinforce a strong Security culture through awareness,  alertness to security risks and public engagement. Ability to equip all levels of Security personnel with the necessary theory, principles and skills to perform their tasks.  Carryout practical exercises involving security personnel and all relevant stakeholders. Conducting Training, education and Security communication.

Name: Stakeholder Management (Ops Security)
Definition: Understanding the needs and requirements of various internal and external stakeholders including RoP, PACA, Oman Air, HSE, AFS etc. Ability to liaise with them for implementation of international security & facilitation laws, policies and controls, emergency situations, risks and threats. Periodically review the gaps in process implementation and sensitize them on any improvement opportunities. Performing all security activities with different internal and external stakeholders with high level of customer service.

Name: Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) Development
Definition: Ability to develop Security related Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and processes in line with ICAO standards and regulatory requirements of PACA. Ability to transfer knowledge to other stakeholders on SOPs, policy and procedures, and other related fields. Includes the ability to review the SOPs periodically and revise them to ensure optimum security at all times.

Name: Enterprise Risk Management
Definition: It is the understanding of the concepts and frameworks related to enterprise risk management. It includes the ability to identify the strategic risks to OA, develop a risk treatment plan and devise a risk mitigation strategy.

Name: Governance (Policies & Procedures)
Definition: It is the knowledge of the OAMC's policies and procedures along with adequate understanding of the application of policy level directives and following the defined processes and authority (as defined in delegation of authority) to ensure effective system of internal controls.

Name: Airport Operations and Safety
Definition: Understanding of the airport operations, airport layout and plan, different stakeholders and their roles and responsibilities and applicable regulations. It includes Knowledge of HSE policies,  processes and procedures as per the applicable HSE standards.

Name: Airport Systems Engineering Principle and Application
Definition: Knowledge of the concepts, principles, theories, and methods related to the system maintenance of AGL, Passenger Boarding Bridges, Visual Docking Guidance, Apron Flood Lighting, Ground Power Unit, Pre-conditioned Air, Vertical and Horizontal Travellators

Name: Asset Information Management
Definition: Ability to define asset information standards and management processes and procedures and asset management reporting mechanism.  It includes the ability to specify and integrate Asset Management IT Systems to provide accurate information on the asset condition, performance and physical location. It also includes maintaining the ongoing integrity and quality of asset data and information.

Name: Asset Performance Monitoring
Definition: It is the ability to define the asset performance standards across the asset portfolio of OA while ensuring alignment with AM policies and procedures. It includes monitoring and reviewing the asset conditions and an ability to carry out root cause analysis for asset defects and failures.

Name: Civil Engineering Principle and Application
Definition: Knowledge of the concepts, principles, theories, and methods related to airfield and landside civil infrastructure maintenance of airport buildings, runways, taxiways and aprons.

Name: Contract Management & Vendor Performance Management
Definition: It is the ability to assess, evaluate and select the right vendors (third-party providers) of materials and services. It includes an ability to set performance standards/ SLA in medium / long term contracts, managing key relationships and ensuring vendors meet the contractual obligations. It also includes managing OA's costs, mitigate risks and maintaining service excellence.

Name: Documentation and Archiving
Definition: It is the ability to maintain adequate documentation. It is the ability to effectively archive the relevant documentation and maintain the confidentiality, integrity and reliability of the  documentation. It is the knowledge of quality standards and frameworks such as ISO 9001 (Quality Management System) and the ability to conduct quality reviews on the documentations

Name: Electrical and Instruments Engineering Principle and Application
Definition: Knowledge of electrical equipment, components, instruments, including their design, installation, testing, uses, calibration, repair, or maintenance. Ability to apply the electrical and instruments engineering techniques when conducting maintenance on instruments associated with the airport operations.

Name: Equipment and System Usage
Definition: Ability to select, operate and use the correct equipment, tools, instruments or systems while undertaking maintenance. Ability to identify failure of equipment, tools, instruments or systems and when maintenance is required. Ability to produce Risk Assessments report associated with the use of the equipment's.

Name: Maintenance Planning
Definition: Ability to plan and develop preventive maintenance schedule by organizing work, setting priorities, determining resource requirements. It includes the ability to balance between operational priorities and those of maintenance by effective stakeholder management and resource allocation. Understanding the impact of shut-down on airport operations.

Name: Mechanical Engineering Principle and Application
Definition: Knowledge of concepts, principles and techniques related to installation, maintenance, operations, repair or maintenance of mechanical equipment systems

Name: Preventive and Corrective Maintenance
Definition: Ability to execute the work order by troubleshooting equipment, instrument or systems, identify failure and defects, conduct root cause analysis to identify the problem and take corrective  and/or preventative action as required within the defined time frame.

Name: Quality Management - TS
Definition: Knowledge of the principles, methods, and tools of quality assurance and quality inspection used to ensure the performed maintenance meets the quality standards required.

Name: Technical Specifications Design
Definition: The ability to assess OA needs of capacity growth and expansion across various airports and develop detailed and standardized designs and technical specifications to optimize the cost of acquisition. It includes working with internal stakeholders to finalize the technical specifications.

Name: Analytical Thinking
Definition: The ability to process large amounts of information in a logical manner, establish connections, cause-and-effect relationships and patterns to address a challenging situation or an issue. includes Integrating theories in practice when addressing challenging situations.

Name: Innovation and Continuous Improvement
Definition: Challenging the conventional way of doing things, generating new, innovative ideas, products / services and effective solutions which continually improve performance.

Name: Problem Solving
Definition: The ability to break down a problem or situation into small components, study it from multiple perspectives, anticipate possible obstacles and identify key actions to solve the problem.

Name: Business Acumen
Definition: It is the ability to interpret market trends to help the organization utilize resources effectively to deliver business results. It is also the understanding of the principles of financial management and the ability to use them to achieve business goals and objectives. It is the ability to prepare a business cases by identifying, sourcing and organizing the information in a logical manner to enhance revenue opportunities. The ability to carry out cost-benefit analysis, including the time value of money, present value concepts, and quantifying tangible and intangible benefits.

Name: Business Performance Reporting
Definition: It is the skill to prepare various MIS/ financial performance reports that are customized as well as standardized for requirements of internal stakeholders. The ability to present those reports to stakeholders. It is also the ability to interpret such reports and share insights on performance of leading and lagging indicators.

Name: Drive for Results
Definition: The ability to drive self and team to achieve higher performance standards of excellence, by establishing stretch performance goals and plan and direct the resources to meet those goals.

Name: Industry knowledge
Definition: It is the understanding of the aviation industry business operations, the internal (knowledge, management, and workforce) and external (economy, competitors, and technology) driving forces, passenger growth, socio-economic factors impacting the aviation industry, and market dynamics. It also includes an overview of the business operations, key cost components, revenue and profitability drivers, and key performance matrices.

Name: Inventory Management
Definition: The ability to plan, forecast and manage the organization's inventory to ensure availability of material, optimized stock holdings and catalogued inventory records.

Name: Operational Excellence
Definition: The ability to drive a culture of first time right performance and operational excellence by ensuring the work is error-free, continuous improvement of operations and meeting customer expectations. It includes innovating working methods to enhance the quality of experience.

Name: Project Management
Definition: Knowledge of the principles, methods, or tools of project management and ability to develop, schedule, coordinate and manage projects and resources. It includes the ability to monitor and inspect costs, work, and contractor performance. In addition, the ability to plan for contingencies and  build them into the project plan.

Name: Risk Management
Definition: It is the understanding of the risks including the skill of identifying and evaluating contractual and financial risks, developing the risk treatment strategy and developing and monitoring the financial and contractual risk controls.

Name: Risk and Business Impact analysis
Definition: Knowledge of the techniques and methodologies of risk assessment and analysis and the business impact analysis, this includes the ability to identify various risks, how to mitigate them, and being able to  identify risk impact.

Name: Risk and Control Assessment Techniques
Definition: Knowledge of the methodologies, criteria and scope of risk assessment such as causal linkage, risk selection, risk mapping, gap analysis, benchmarking. It includes the ability to test the controls in terms of data inputs, logical access controls and authorization, exception handling and logging and segregation of duties. Knowledge of the preventive, detective and corrective controls and the ability to test the effectiveness of those controls.

Name: Service Delivery
Definition: Discovers the needs of "Internal" and "External" OA customers and strives to deliver services to meet their needs.

Name: Stakeholder Management(Common)
Definition: Knowledge and understanding of different stakeholders, their needs, priorities and agenda. It includes actively engaging and partnering with them to achieve a common objective.

Name: Store Management
Definition: The ability to manage the inflow, storage, and outflow of materials through the organization's stores, while verifying that inventory present in stores matches system records and investigating any variances.

Name: Tendering
Definition: It is the knowledge and understanding of the tendering lifecycle, working with end users to ensure that the materials/services procured are aligned with business needs and within the available budget. It also includes the ability to finalize the evaluation criteria and negotiate with vendors.

Name: Agility
Definition: Demonstrates positive attitude, resilience and openness to changes in Oman Airports technological, commercial or business environment, processes and structure. It implies adapting one’s approach as the requirements of a situation change, being comfortable in ambiguous situations and working effectively within a variety of situations and with various individuals or groups of diverse backgrounds and experiences.

Name: Communication
Definition: The ability to convey a message using appropriate channels, to both individuals and groups, actively listen to the response and successfully hold their attention to achieve the desired impact. The ability to influence others, build consensus through give and take, gain cooperation from others to obtain information and accomplish objectives.

Name: Emotional Intelligence (EI or EQ)
Definition: The ability to monitor one’s own and other’s emotions; discriminate between different emotions and label them appropriately; and use emotional information to guide thinking and behavior.

Name: Team work
Definition:
The ability to effectively work with and support others as
part of a team, both within and across functions, and
building and maintaining positive relationships at all levels
with cultural sensitivity, showing respect & effectively
working with diversity

Name: Time Management
Definition: The skill of managing time effectively by planning, organizing, and controlling the hours spent on different activities.. Good time management enables to work smarter – not harder – and get more done in less time, even when time is tight and pressures are high. Failing to manage your time damages effectiveness and causes stress.

Name: Leading Change
Definition: Commitment to improving the business, enabling the process of change and transition and leading others to adapt well to change. Knows and uses various change methodologies appropriately at the individual, team and organizational level. Aware of the history of change in OA and is skilled at applying appropriate lessons from past change journey

Name: Leading and Coaching Team
Definition: Drives a high performance culture by empowering team members, effectively delegating work and recognize and appreciate contribution. The ability to understand team members needs and aspirations and an ability to provide constructive feedback to improve their performance at work. It includes acting as a coach and mentor and developing others in realizing their career aspirations.

Name: Negotiation
Definition:
Negotiation is the ability to work towards win-win outcomes. 
is a dialogue between two or more people or parties intended to reach a beneficial outcome over one or more conflict. Negotiation is an interaction and process between entities who aspire to agree on matters of mutual interest, while optimizing their individual utilities.

Name: Strategic Thinking
Definition: The ability to formulate objectives and priorities, implement plans consistent with the long-term interests of the organization in a global environment and capitalize on opportunities and manage risks. It also includes the ability to structure, analyze and synthesize information in the process of making decisions to ensure that all relevant factors are considered and decision meets desired objectives.
